title: Okta Migration Profile
description: Machine-readable operator declaration of migration choices for the Okta → Entra identity migration framework. Nested under migration_profile: in .secops/identity/okta.yaml.

identity_authority.description: Who is the authoritative identity source: Okta, an upstream HRIS (Workday/etc.), or mixed per-attribute.

hris_system.description: Name of the HRIS system (e.g. workday, successfactors). Required when identity_authority is hris or mixed; otherwise null.

per_class_ownership.description: Authoritative WRITER for each object class. Only classes declared 'entra' accept writes from migration tooling.

per_attribute_authority.description: Optional per-field authority overrides (e.g. manager from HRIS, custom attrs from Okta).

authority.description: Which system is authoritative for this attribute.

cutover_shape.description: How the cutover will be executed: all at once, app-by-app, or population-by-population.

group_strategy.description: lift_and_shift: recreate all Okta groups in Entra as-is. rationalize: map to Entra dynamic groups / access packages.

federation_direction.description: Federation trust direction during and after migration.

mfa_strategy.description: How users will re-enroll MFA in Entra after cutover.

dry_run.description: When true, all state-changing operations are simulated — no live writes.

entra_write_tooling.description: Tooling used for Entra-side writes. none = read-only / not yet configured.
